 Buriram United Holds Kashima Antlers, Fierce Duel Colors AFC Champions League Elite
 Buriram United and Kashima Antlers played a tight match in the 2026/2027 AFC Champions League Elite at Buriram Stadium, Thailand, on Wednesday (11/4/2026).
 By: Damar Prasetya 
 | 
 Editor: Nayla Savitri 
 | 
 Contributor: Keisya Anjani 
 November 4, 2026, 22:22 WITA · 5 min read 
 Image caption: Illustration of the Buriram United vs Kashima Antlers match in the 2026/2027 AFC Champions League Elite, Wednesday (11/4/2026). (Illustration/Aktualita.co) 
 BURIRAM, Aktualita.co -  The match Buriram United vs Kashima Antlers in the 2026/2027 AFC Champions League Elite was a tight contest at Buriram Stadium or Chang Arena, Thailand, on Wednesday (11/4/2026) evening. 
 The Thai representative faced heavy resistance from Kashima Antlers, who arrived with a perfect record in their previous three matches. However, the visitors from Japan were unable to break the deadlock as the game entered its final minutes. 
 Advertisement 
 Based on match updates recorded on the official J.League website, the score for Buriram United vs Kashima Antlers remained 0-0 as of the 86th minute. No goals had been recorded for either side in that update. 
 The match, which kicked off at 19:15 Thailand time or 20:15 WITA, was the fourth game for both teams in the East Region league phase of the 2026/2027 AFC Champions League Elite. 
 Kashima Antlers More Aggressive in the First Half 
 Kashima Antlers displayed an attacking game from the first half. The Japanese club attempted to control the flow of the match and find gaps in the host's defense. 
 Official J.League statistics show that Kashima unleashed eight shots throughout the first 45 minutes. Two of them were on target. 
 Conversely, Buriram United recorded only one shot attempt with none on target. 
 Kashima also earned three corner kicks, while Buriram only had one. In terms of passing accuracy, the visitors recorded 81 percent compared to the host's 77 percent. 
 This difference illustrates how Kashima created threats more frequently. However, the abundance of opportunities was not enough to give Toru Oniki's side the lead. 
 Buriram managed to maintain a scoreless draw until halftime. This condition serves as an important foundation for the hosts, who had yet to secure a win in this season's Asian competition. 
 Buriram United Plays with a New Coach 
 The meeting against Kashima Antlers was also an important test for Buriram United following a coaching change. 
 The club, nicknamed the Thunder Castle, appointed Spanish coach Raul Caneda to replace Mario Silva, who left his position at the end of October 2026. 
 Caneda has experience managing several Asian clubs, including Al Ittihad and Al Nassr in Saudi Arabia. His presence is expected to improve Buriram's inconsistent performance from the start of the season. 
 In a press conference ahead of the match on Tuesday (11/3/2026), Caneda acknowledged the strength of Kashima Antlers. However, he emphasized his belief in his players' abilities. 
 "Kashima Antlers is a club of very high quality, but I also believe in our players. This match will be difficult, but we have prepared well," said Caneda, as translated from the club's official statement. 
 Buriram United player Kenneth Dougall also emphasized the importance of utilizing the support of the fans at home. 
 According to him, facing a Japanese club requires high concentration and discipline. Buriram must be able to maximize every opportunity so as not to lose points in front of their supporters. 
 Kashima Antlers' Performance More Convincing 
 Before traveling to Thailand, Kashima Antlers appeared impressive with three consecutive wins in the AFC Champions League Elite league phase. 
 They opened their journey with a 7-1 big win over Newcastle Jets on September 15, 2026. 
 Kashima then defeated Cong An Ha Noi 1-0 on October 13. That success was followed by a 3-0 victory over Pohang Steelers on October 28. 
 From those three matches, Kashima collected nine points with 11 goals scored and only one conceded. 
 That record placed the Japanese club at the top of the East Region standings before the match against Buriram took place. 
 Conversely, Buriram United had a more difficult journey. They opened the competition with a 1-1 draw against Johor Darul Ta'zim. 
 In the second match, Buriram had to accept a 0-1 defeat to Beijing FC. The opportunity to win also did not materialize when facing Gamba Osaka on October 28. 
 In that match, Buriram had taken the lead through an Eduardo Mancha goal before Gamba Osaka equalized to make it 1-1. 
 That result left Buriram with two points from three matches before hosting Kashima. 
 Substitutions Color the Second Half 
 Entering the second half, both teams made several adjustments to change the course of the match. 
 Kashima brought on several players, including Leo Ceara and Elber in the 56th minute. Their presence provided additional options for the visitors' attacking line. 
 Coach Toru Oniki also made changes in the midfield and defense sectors. Matheus Bueno came on to replace Yuta Higuchi, while Ryoya Ogawa received playing time in the second half. 
 For the hosts, Buriram made changes by bringing on Paulinho and Caju from the start of the second half. Sebas Moyano also had the opportunity to appear as the match entered its final phase. 
 Although a number of substitutions were made, the score remained unchanged in the match records up to the 86th minute. 
 Kenneth Dougall received a yellow card in that minute. The situation showed the importance of maintaining discipline as the match entered a crucial phase. 
 Competition for the Round of 16 Gets Tighter 
 The result of the Buriram United vs Kashima Antlers match has significant meaning for both teams in the race for a ticket to the AFC Champions League Elite round of 16. 
 Kashima arrived with the opportunity to strengthen its position at the top. An additional win would bring the Japanese team closer to the knockout phase. 
 Meanwhile, Buriram needs points to improve its position in the standings after going through three matches without a win. 
 In this season's competition format, the eight best teams from each region will continue their journey to the round of 16. 
 Therefore, every point has an influence on a club's chances of remaining in the competition. 
 For Buriram, the success of providing resistance against Kashima could be the starting point for a revival after the coaching change. 
 Meanwhile, for Kashima, this match serves as a reminder that a perfect winning record does not always guarantee ease when facing opponents on their home turf. 
 The next match also awaits. Buriram is scheduled to face Shanghai Port on November 24, 2026, while Kashima Antlers will meet Jeonbuk Hyundai Motors on November 25, 2026. 
 Match notes: The last verifiable official update showed a score of Buriram United 0-0 Kashima Antlers up to the 86th minute. The final result of the match still requires further confirmation.
